snippet.title: Shroud of Gloom - Demo Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
🧡 PLAY THE DEMO ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4058240/Shroud_of_Gloom_Demo/
👾 Join the Discord ► https://discord.com/invite/cFFBq6g
🔴 Follow the development on Twitch ► https://www.twitch.tv/madchirpy

Shroud of Gloom is a point-and-click indie horror game. Solve puzzles, collect items and uncover secrets with nothing but a flickering flashlight to guide your way. Can you escape the dark and make it out alive?

The game combines the charm and nostalgia of classic point-and-click adventures with a chilling horror atmosphere. Explore an old manor shrouded in mystery, solve puzzles rooted in your surroundings, and uncover the secrets of this forgotten place - it may seem abandoned at first glance, but you’re certain that you are not alone.

Shroud of Gloom is a deeply personal project from two lifelong friends: one solo developer and one sound designer. It’s the result of passion, persistence, and countless late nights.

Your support means the world - play the demo now and wishlist the game to be notified on release.

#indiegame #trailer #teaser
